### Sampled logging
- What: Keep only a share of routine logs once there are too many to store.
- Applies when: logs have become too large.
- Stage: at-scale
- Kind: checkable

### Upstream call log
- What: Record every call to a paid outside service, with what it cost.
- Applies when: the app calls paid outside services.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Per-request cost
- What: Work out what each request costs in paid services.
- Applies when: each request costs real money.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Cost alerts
- What: Get a warning before a pay-per-use bill passes a limit you set.
- Applies when: the app is going live and uses pay-per-use services.
- Stage: go-live
- Kind: checkable
